caseNameFull: William A. LIVINGSTON v. Pat FRANK, Clerk, Circuit Court of Hillsborough County, Florida

opinions.text: Motion of Cato Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Motion of Owners' Counsel of America for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the District Court of Appeal of Florida, Second District denied.
